page.layout: One printed page. Full-width heading "II." at top; below it two parallel verse columns (left and right), separated by a vertical rule. Below them, full-width: a Greek line with "p.", the author name, then "III." with its verse, the signature line, "IV." with its verse, "V." with Greek verse, and the printer's name line at the foot. A library stamp sits at the lower right, beside the Greek verse, and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Felix est animi Dædala quem suis
Finxit Te manibus Clio suis sacra
Falleris Ausoni Præsul, qui dogma nefandum,
Purgantem hinc ignem, cudere ritè cupis.
Purpureo CHRISTI jam sunt qui sanguine loti,
Si tu, síque tui Stygiis immergier undis
Mavultis, per me, crede, manere licet.
Quòd patet, hinc laus est certa reposta tibi.
Pro fato functis quondam qui flumine lori,
Ἐιρεσίης ἀρξης ταλάγγες μέγα κῦδ[?] ἀροιο,
Αἱ γὰρ σε ςομάτεσιν ἀνηρείψαντο μέλιτσαι.

page.notes: The Greek verse under V. is only partly legible at this scan resolution; the readings marked [?] are doubtful. Greek lines are copied as best read. The library stamp (STADT-BIBLIOTHEK ZUERICH) is not transcribed. The printed "p." after the first Greek line and the bare numerals are kept as printed. The verse lines are copied with their printed line breaks, which may not correspond exactly to the source layout.
